channel.title: Noticky
channel.description: Updates for Noticky, a native macOS sticky-note app.

item.title: v2.5.0
item.description:
New

  • Images in notes — paste a screenshot, or copy an image file in Finder and paste it into a note. The image is kept in the note library rather than as a link to a file on disk, so moving or deleting the original does not break it, and it syncs to your other Macs through iCloud.
  • Remote images — ![alt](https://…) renders inline. Downloaded once and cached.
  • Image panel — a new button in the manager window's toolbar lists every image a note holds, with thumbnails, and puts any of them back into the text. An image outlives the line that points at it, so deleting that line by accident no longer loses the picture.
  • Highlight — ==highlighted text== is now supported, with a Highlight entry in the right-click Format menu.

Improved

  • The right-click Format menu is back: bold, italic, headings and lists.
  • An image's line in the source now reads ![[name|id]] in full. The id used to be hidden, and a few ordinary edits — deleting a bracket, retyping the name, copying the line — quietly took it away and left a picture nothing could find. It is in the text now, where nothing can lose it.
  • Updated the Markdown editor engine: block formulas typeset properly, tables follow the window width while you resize, and numbered lists keep their painted numbers under the caret.
  • Long note and group names in the menu bar are shortened by how wide they actually draw, so the menu keeps its shape.
  • Note titles no longer show == or ~~ markers.

View full release on GitHub →

新增

  • 便签里的图片 —— 截图直接粘贴，或者在访达里拷贝图片文件再粘进便签。图片存在便签库里，不是指向磁盘上某个文件的链接，所以原文件移动或删除都不影响它，还会通过 iCloud 同步到你的其他 Mac。
  • 网络图片 —— ![alt](https://…) 直接渲染，下载一次后本地缓存。
  • 图片面板 —— 管理窗口工具栏新增一个按钮，列出这条便签的所有图片（带缩略图），可以把其中任意一张放回正文。图片的寿命比指向它的那一行长，所以误删了那一行，图也不会跟着没。
  • 高亮 —— 支持 ==高亮文字==，右键「格式」菜单里也加了高亮。

改进

  • 右键 格式 菜单回来了：粗体、斜体、标题、列表。
  • 图片那一行的源码现在完整显示成 ![[名称|id]]。这个 id 以前是藏起来的，而几种很普通的编辑 —— 删一个括号、重打名字、复制这一行 —— 会悄悄把它弄掉，留下一张谁也找不到的图。现在它就在正文里，丢不了。
  • 升级了 Markdown 编辑器引擎：块级公式排版正确了，表格会跟着窗口宽度实时调整，有序列表的编号在光标经过时不再跳回源码里的数字。
  • 菜单栏里过长的便签名和分组名，按实际绘制宽度截断，菜单不再被撑变形。
  • 便签标题不再显示 ==、~~ 这些标记符号。

在 GitHub 查看完整更新 →

item.title: v2.4.0
item.description:
New

  • Agent access via MCP — Perch can now run a local MCP server so AI agents (Claude Code, etc.) can read and search your notes and groups. Turn it on in the new Settings → Agent tab. Off by default.
  • Write access is opt-in — creating, editing, moving, pinning, archiving and deleting notes by an agent requires a separate "Allow agents to write" switch. Deletes go to Trash like normal, and pinning opens a real sticky window.
  • Secure by default — the server listens on this Mac only (127.0.0.1) and requires a token, which is stored in the Keychain. The Agent tab shows ready-to-copy client configuration.

Improved

  • The Settings window is wider so all tabs fit in the toolbar without an overflow "»" menu.

View full release on GitHub →

新增

  • 通过 MCP 让 AI 助手访问便签 — Perch 现在可以在本机运行 MCP 服务，让 AI 助手（如 Claude Code）读取和搜索你的便签与分组。在新增的 设置 → Agent 页开启，默认关闭。
  • 写入权限需单独开启 — 助手创建、编辑、移动、置顶、归档或删除便签，需要另外打开「允许 Agent 写入」开关。删除操作同样进入回收站，置顶会真正打开便签窗口。
  • 默认安全 — 服务只监听本机（127.0.0.1），并需要访问令牌，令牌保存在钥匙串中。Agent 设置页提供可直接复制的客户端配置。

改进

  • 设置窗口加宽，所有设置页都能在工具栏中直接显示，不再折叠到「»」菜单里。

在 GitHub 查看完整更新 →

item.title: v2.3.0
item.description:
New

  • Stickies remember their display — each sticky remembers which display it belongs to. Drag it to another screen and it stays there after reopening or relaunching. Unplug a display and its stickies move to the main screen; plug it back in and they return. "Move All to Display" is now remembered too.
  • Menu bar icon click actions — choose separately what left-click and right-click on the menu bar icon do: show the menu, or open Manage All Notes.
  • Dock icon for Manage All Notes — optionally show Perch in the Dock and the app switcher (⌘Tab) while the Manage All Notes window is open.
  • Default menu visibility for new groups — choose whether newly created groups appear in the menu bar note list.
  • Manager remembers the last note — Manage All Notes reopens with the note you last selected.
  • New "Menu Bar" settings tab — menu bar options moved out of General, so the General tab is shorter.

Improved

  • The "hidden from menu bar" icon in the manager sidebar is easier to see.
  • Group names and note titles in the manager sidebar stay readable when the window is inactive, turning slightly gray as other macOS apps do.

View full release on GitHub →

新增

  • 便签记住所属显示器 — 每条便签会记住自己所在的显示器。拖到另一块屏幕后，重新打开或重启都会回到那块屏幕；拔掉显示器时便签暂时移到主屏幕，插回后自动归位。「全部移到显示器」也会被记住。
  • 菜单栏图标点击行为 — 可分别设置左键和右键点击菜单栏图标时的动作：显示菜单，或打开「管理所有便签」。
  • 管理窗口显示 Dock 图标 — 可选在「管理所有便签」窗口打开期间，让 Perch 出现在 Dock 和 ⌘Tab 应用切换器中。
  • 新分组默认是否显示在菜单栏 — 可设置新建的分组是否出现在菜单栏的便签列表中。
  • 管理窗口记住上次选中的笔记 — 再次打开「管理所有便签」时，自动选中上次查看的笔记。
  • 新增「菜单栏」设置页 — 菜单栏相关选项从「通用」移出，「通用」页更简短。

改进

  • 管理窗口侧边栏中「在菜单栏隐藏」的图标更清晰。
  • 窗口不在前台时，侧边栏的分组名和笔记标题会适度变灰，但保持清晰可读，与 macOS 其他应用一致。

在 GitHub 查看完整更新 →

item.title: v2.2.0
item.description:
New

  • Multi-select group display — the tray "Display" menu now shows several groups' stickies at once (each group toggles on/off independently), instead of only one group at a time. "Show All Stickies" checks every group.
  • Hide groups from the menu bar — right-click a group in the manager to keep its notes out of the menu bar list. Hidden groups are marked with an icon in the sidebar.

Fixed

  • Note content loss in the manager (important) — editing notes while switching between them in the manager window could write one note's text into another and lose the original. Fixed.
  • Clicking a sticky no longer jumps back and forth between virtual desktops (Spaces).
  • "Show All Stickies" no longer stays checked after "Hide All Stickies".

View full release on GitHub →

新增

  • 分组显示多选 — 托盘「显示」菜单现在可同时显示多个分组的便签（每个分组独立勾选开/关），不再是一次只能看一组。「显示所有便签」= 全部分组勾选。
  • 在菜单栏隐藏分组 — 在管理窗口右键分组，即可把它的笔记从菜单栏列表里隐藏；被隐藏的分组在侧栏有图标标记。

修复

  • 管理窗口笔记内容丢失（重要） — 在管理窗口连续切换编辑不同笔记时，可能把一条笔记的内容写进另一条并覆盖原文。已修复。
  • 点击便签不再在多个虚拟桌面（Spaces）之间来回跳转。
  • 「隐藏所有便签」之后，「显示所有便签」不再错误地保持勾选。

在 GitHub 查看完整更新 →

item.title: v2.1.0
item.description:
What's New

New Features

  • All Tasks view — A new "All Tasks" entry in the manager sidebar gathers every open to-do (- [ ]) from across all your notes into one place, grouped by source note. Check one off and it writes straight back to the original note; sub-tasks keep their nesting.
  • Quick group switching from the menu bar — A new Display submenu lets you show just one group's notes with a single click, hiding everything else — perfect for jumping between contexts. Your choice is remembered across launches.
  • Tray menu grouping — Settings → General now lets you organize the menu bar note list as a flat list (default), grouped sections, or collapsible submenus.
  • Global shortcut for Float on Top — Record your own hotkey in Settings → Shortcuts to toggle Float on Top from anywhere.

Improvements

  • One unified editor — The note editor is now the live WYSIWYG Markdown editor everywhere, with inline styling, code, images, math, and task lists. The old two-mode (render/source) editor and its experimental settings toggles have been retired.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0

View full release on GitHub →

更新内容

新功能

  • All Tasks 任务总览 —— 管理窗口侧边栏新增「All Tasks」入口，把所有便签里未完成的待办（- [ ]）汇总到一处，按来源便签分组。勾选后会直接写回原便签；子任务保留层级关系。
  • 菜单栏快速切换分组 —— 新增「显示」子菜单，点一下即可只显示某个分组的便签、隐藏其余，方便在不同场景间切换。所选分组会在下次启动时记住。
  • 托盘菜单分组 —— 设置 → 通用 中可选择菜单栏便签列表的组织方式：平铺列表（默认）、分组标题，或可折叠的子菜单。
  • Float on Top 全局快捷键 —— 在 设置 → 快捷键 中自定义热键，随时切换「置顶」。

优化

  • 统一的编辑器 —— 便签编辑器现在统一为实时 WYSIWYG Markdown 编辑器，支持行内样式、代码、图片、数学公式和任务列表。旧的双模式（渲染/源码）编辑器及相关实验性设置开关已移除。

item.title: v2.0.0
item.description:
Noticky is now Perch

Noticky has a new name, a new look, and a new home — meet Perch. Your notes come along for the ride.

What changed

  • New name & icon. Noticky is now Perch, with a fresh menu bar icon — a little bird perched on a branch.
  • Same app, same notes. Everything you know is still here. This is a rename, not a rewrite.

Upgrading from Noticky — please read

  • Perch is a separate app. Because of the rename, your existing Noticky won't auto-update to Perch. Download Perch once from the link below, then you can move the old Noticky to the Trash.
  • Your notes are imported automatically. The first time you open Perch, it brings over all your notes and groups from Noticky (duplicates are skipped), then asks whether to keep or delete the old Noticky data — Keep is the default, so nothing is removed unless you choose to.
  • iCloud sync starts fresh. Perch uses a new iCloud container, so previously synced data doesn't carry over on its own. Your local notes are imported as above; turn on iCloud in Settings to sync from here.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.4.0...v2.0.0

View full release on GitHub →

Noticky 现已更名为 Perch

Noticky 换了新名字、新图标、新家 —— 它现在叫 Perch（栖息）。你的便签会一起搬过来。

主要变化

  • 全新名字与图标。 Noticky 现已更名为 Perch，菜单栏也换上了新图标 —— 一只栖在枝头的小鸟。
  • 还是那个 app、那些便签。 你熟悉的一切都在，这只是改名，不是重写。

从 Noticky 升级 —— 请阅读

  • Perch 是一个独立的 app。 由于改名，你现有的 Noticky 不会自动更新到 Perch。请通过下方链接下载一次 Perch，之后即可把旧的 Noticky 移到废纸篓。
  • 你的便签会自动导入。 首次打开 Perch 时，它会把 Noticky 里的所有便签和分组带过来（自动跳过重复项），然后询问你要保留还是删除旧的 Noticky 数据 —— 默认是「保留」，不主动选择就不会删除任何东西。
  • iCloud 同步会重新开始。 Perch 使用了新的 iCloud 容器，之前云端同步的数据不会自动迁移。你的本地便签会按上面的方式导入；在 设置 里开启 iCloud 即可从现在重新同步。

完整更新日志: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.4.0...v2.0.0

item.title: v1.4.0
item.description:
What's New

Note Colors

  • New Rainbow (炫彩) color — a vivid rainbow gradient for your stickies. The note background uses a soft, readable version while pickers show the vivid one.
  • Random default color — set Default color to Random in Settings → Notes and every new note picks its own color.

Resizing

  • Preset sizes in the ⋯ menu — switch a floating note between Small / Medium / Large with a single click, just like changing color. Tile and Stack layouts re-align automatically afterward.
  • Cycle-size shortcut — assign a global shortcut in Settings → Shortcuts to cycle the focused note through Small → Medium → Large.

Tasks

  • Task progress pie — notes containing checkboxes now show a completion pie on the sticky title bar and in the manager list.

Under the Hood

  • Noticky now enforces a single running instance, so launching it again just surfaces the existing app instead of starting a second copy.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an intermittent crash that could happen on actions that save a note (e.g. collapsing a sticky), caused by a data race in Spotlight indexing.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.3.3...v1.4.0

更新内容

便签颜色

  • 新增炫彩配色 —— 给便签来一抹鲜艳的彩虹渐变。便签背景用柔和、易读的版本，颜色选择器里则显示鲜艳版。
  • 随机默认色 —— 在 设置 → 便签 里把默认颜色设为「随机」，每张新便签都会自动挑一个颜色。

尺寸调整

  • ⋯ 菜单里的预设尺寸 —— 像切换颜色一样，一键把浮窗便签切到 小 / 中 / 大。切换后平铺、堆叠布局会自动重新对齐。
  • 尺寸循环快捷键 —— 在 设置 → 快捷键 里指定一个全局快捷键，循环切换当前便签的 小 → 中 → 大。

任务

  • 任务进度饼 —— 含复选框的便签会在标题栏和管理列表里显示一个完成度饼图。

底层改进

  • Noticky 现在会确保只运行一个实例，再次启动只会唤起已有窗口，而不是再开一个副本。

问题修复

  • 修复了一个偶发崩溃 —— 在保存便签的操作（例如折叠便签）时可能触发，根因是 Spotlight 索引的数据竞争。

完整更新日志: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.3.3...v1.4.0

item.title: v1.3.3
item.description:
What's New

Spotlight Fix

  • Rewrote Spotlight indexing to use manual CSSearchableIndex — fixes cases where notes were not appearing in Spotlight results on some macOS configurations.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3

item.title: v1.3.2
item.description:
What's New

Spotlight Integration

  • Notes are now indexed in macOS Spotlight. Search for any note from Spotlight and click the result to open it directly in Noticky.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

item.title: v1.3.1
item.description:
What's New

Floating Note Polish

  • Note order persists across restarts — floating notes reopen in the same stacking order you left them.
  • Smooth collapse/expand animation — sticky notes now fold and unfold with a fluid animation instead of snapping.
  • Collapsed sticky bar is now vertically centered for a tidier look.
  • New color swatch row in the floating-note ⋯ menu with a ring hover effect — change note color without opening Settings.
  • Update checks now surface quietly in the menu bar instead of interrupting you with a popup.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a glitch where the floating-note ⋯ menu could collapse unexpectedly; menu now uses native Menu with hover-only buttons.
  • Fixed the reminder bell icon overlapping long note titles.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1

item.title: v1.3.0
item.description:
What's New

Markdown Editor (Experimental)

  • New WYSIWYG Markdown editor powered by swift-markdown-engine. Write in plain Markdown and see it rendered live — toggle between edit and preview in the note header.

Library Export & Import

  • Export your entire library as SQLite or Markdown files for backup or migration.
  • Import a Noticky SQLite backup directly — useful for restoring from a manual backup or moving between Macs.

Settings

  • Added Clear All Content in Settings → General — wipes all notes and groups with a single confirmation. Useful for a fresh start.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed: pinned notes imported from a backup now correctly appear as floating windows immediately after import.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.2.3...v1.3.0

item.title: v1.2.3
item.description:
What's New

Archive

  • Notes now have a third state: Archived. Move notes out of your way without sending them to Trash — they stay searchable and recoverable anytime.

Menu Bar Badge

  • Optional note-count badge on the menu bar icon. Choose between: off, count all notes, or count only visible notes. Configure it in Settings.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.2.2...v1.2.3

item.title: v1.2.2
item.description:
What's New

Localization

  • Settings tabs now live-refresh when you switch the app language — no restart needed.
  • Permissions settings merged into the Capture tab for a cleaner layout.

New App Icon

  • Fresh graphite + cream-paper icon — a cleaner, more timeless look that fits right in on macOS.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2

item.title: v1.2.1
item.description:
What's New

Display Management

  • Move All Stickies now respects the current screen layout and anchors new positions relative to existing windows — notes land where you expect them.
  • Removed the per-note display pin in favor of the unified Move All action in the menu bar, keeping the interface cleaner.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

item.title: v1.2.0
item.description:
What's New

Auto-update

  • Integrated Sparkle 2 — Noticky now checks for updates and installs them in-place automatically.

Reminders

  • Added per-note one-shot local notifications — set a reminder on any sticky note and get notified at the chosen time.

Note Manager

  • Rebuilt the manager sidebar using NSOutlineView for native macOS drag-and-drop reordering and grouping.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/xVanTuring/Perch/commits/v1.2.0
